        "note": "Calls LZ4_compress_default with srcSize=468566, dstCapacity=1754; dstCapacity is much smaller than LZ4_compressBound(srcSize)"
    },
    {
        "step": 3,
        "file": "lib/lz4.c",
        "function": "LZ4_compress_default",
        "line": 1233,
        "var": "result",
        "code": "return LZ4_compress_fast(src, dst, srcSize, maxOutputSize, 1)",
        "note": "Forwards to LZ4_compress_fast with acceleration=1"
    },
    {
        "step": 4,
        "file": "lib/lz4.c",
        "function": "LZ4_compress_fast",
        "line": 1222,
        "var": "result",
        "code": "result = LZ4_compress_fast_extState(ctxPtr, source, dest, inputSize, maxOutputSize, acceleration)",
        "note": "Forwards to LZ4_compress_fast_extState"
    },
    {
        "step": 5,
        "file": "lib/lz4.c",
        "function": "LZ4_compress_fast_extState",
        "line": 1161,
        "var": "outputDirective",
        "code": "if (maxOutputSize >= LZ4_compressBound(inputSize)) { ... } else { outputDirective = limitedOutput; }",
        "note": "maxOutputSize=1754 < LZ4_compressBound(468566)=470419, so limitedOutput path is selected"
    },
    {
        "step": 6,
        "file": "lib/lz4.c",
        "function": "LZ4_compress_generic",
        "line": 967,
        "var": "olimit",
        "code": "if ((outputDirective == limitedOutput) && (unlikely(op + litLength + (2 + 1 + LASTLITERALS) + (litLength/255) > olimit))) { return 0; }",
        "note": "Literal encoding overflow check; passes because litLength is small enough relative to olimit"
    },
    {
        "step": 7,
        "file": "lib/lz4.c",
        "function": "LZ4_compress_generic",
        "line": 1016,
        "var": "matchCode",
        "code": "if ((outputDirective) && (unlikely(op + (1 + LASTLITERALS) + (matchCode>>8) > olimit))) { ... return 0; }",
        "note": "Match encoding overflow check uses matchCode>>8 which underestimates space needed for 4-byte LZ4_write32 writes when matchCode >= ML_MASK"
    },
    {
        "step": 8,
        "file": "lib/lz4.c",
        "function": "LZ4_compress_generic",
        "line": 1027,
        "var": "matchCode",
        "code": "if (matchCode >= ML_MASK) { *token += ML_MASK; matchCode -= ML_MASK; LZ4_write32(op, 0xFFFFFFFF); }",
        "note": "matchCode >= ML_MASK (15), enters the long match encoding path"
    },
    {
        "step": 9,
        "file": "lib/lz4.c",
        "function": "LZ4_compress_generic",
        "line": 1033,
        "var": "op",
        "code": "LZ4_write32(op, 0xFFFFFFFF)",
        "note": "HEAP-BUFFER-OVERFLOW WRITE 4: writes 0xFFFFFFFF at op which is past the end of the 1754-byte dst buffer; the overflow check at step 7 failed to reserve enough space"
    }
]

with open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(trace, f, indent=2)

print("Trace written successfully")
print(f"Trace length: {len(trace)} steps")
PYEOF
